caption:
Settlement is the final formal step between approval and actually having funds available — confirming any last conditions, executing documentation, and registering security where relevant.

Understanding this stage in advance means you can plan realistically around when the finance will genuinely be ready to use, rather than assuming it happens the moment you're approved.
